text:
```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR number'
        required: true
        type: number

jobs:
  bump_version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Get GitHub App token
        id: get-app-token
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: api.github.com
          scope: repo
          policy: '{"Version": "2012-10-17","Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["repo:status"],"Resource": "*"}]}'

      - name: Run bump version command
        run: |
          airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Create comment with next steps
        run: |
          echo "::add-comment::${
            cat <<EOF
            ## Next Steps
            1. Review the updated connector version.
            2. Merge the PR once the version has been verified.
            EOF
          }"
```
